description: This source file defines the 'Add' feature for followers, handling the process of a user following another user. It includes a command class, a validator, and an asynchronous handler that manages database interactions to establish follower relationships and returns profile information.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Encapsulates the command, validator, and handler for adding a follower to a user.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the command to follow a user, updates the database, and returns the followed user's profile.
